parole.significato: A hunting dog (for aiding human hunters) of a particular African breed.
parole.testo: From Lingala mbwá na basɛ́nzi (“dogs of the savages; dogs of the villagers”). First use appears c. 1906.

parole.significato: A musical instrument found in sub-Saharan Africa; a kind of lamellophone.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Lingala likembé, from li- + kembé.

parole.significato: A large water-dwelling cryptid described in legends of the Congo River basin.
parole.testo: From Lingala mokɛle-mbɛmbe, possibly meaning "one who stops the flow of rivers", or "rainbow".

parole.significato: The shell of Olivella nana, used as currency.
